title: The Cipher of Windrow House
author: E. M. Iversen
blurb: Ada Montrose, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
